text.body:
bhaṭṭakumārilasvāmipraṇītāḥ atha dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ |
<1 śravaṇākarma |>
bruve'tha śravaṇākarma sarpabalyākhyakarma ca | kurvanti śrāvaṇe māsi paurṇamāsyāmidaṃ dvayam pūrayedahni kalaśaṃ navaṃ yāvakasaktubhiḥ | nidhāya taṃ nave śikye darvī vaikaṅkatīmapi || prācyāṃ diśi śuciṃ deśaṃ balyarthaṃ parigṛhya ca | yavadhānā vimajyaikaṃ bhāgamabhyajya sarpiṣā āditye'stamite kuryādanvādhānādi pūrvavat | havirdvayasya tūṣṇīṃ sto nirvāpaprokṣaṇe iha purovadavaghātādi syādvibhajya ca taṇḍulān | tatraikena puroḍāśamanyena śrapayeccarum || ekasmiṃstu puroḍāśaṃ kapāle śrapayediha | ājyena saha dhānānāṃ paryagnikaraṇaṃ bhavet || ājyasya kevalotpūtau tāsāṃ triḥ prokṣaṇaṃ bhavet | (carumāsādayetpūrvaṃ puroḍāśamataḥ param) barhiṣyājyāntare kṛtsnaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nimajjayet | prakāśapṛṣṭhamathavā puroḍāśaṃ nimajjayet atha kṛtvā''jyabhāgāntaṃ carvāhuticatuṣṭayam | hutvā catuṣṭayenāgne nayeti pratyṛcaṃ tataḥ| upastīryātha savyena dakṣiṇe prokṣite kare | savyenaikakapāla tamopya kṛtsnamakhaṇḍitam || upariṣṭāttu savyena kuryāddvirabhighāraṇam | acyutāyeti mantreṇa dakṣiṇena juhotyatha || yasminnājye nimagno'yaṃ sruveṇaiva juhoti tat | uparyekakapālasya māno agne iti tyṛcā athopastaraṇādyanyaḥ karoti gṛhiṇo'ñjalau | sa tena juhuyādaktā dhānāḥ śaṃ no bhavantviti yāstu dhānā anabhyaktā putrādibhyo dadāti tāḥ | atha sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvā carudhānaikadaśetaḥ pariṣecanaparyantaṃ homaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | ityuktaṃ śravaṇākarma sarpabalyāmukhyacyate || 15 || iti śravaṇākarma |
<2 sarpabaliḥ >
atha prapūrayeddarvīṃ saktubhiḥ kalaśasthitaiḥ| gṛhātprāgupaniṣkramya śucau deśe'hni kalpite apa āsicya tānopya sarpadeveti mantrataḥ | nāntarā balimātmānaṃ vyaveyādiha kaścana || vyavāyasya niṣedho'yamukta āparidānataḥ | ye sarpā iti maṃtreṇa namaskuryātkṛtāñjaliḥ || baliṃ pradakṣiṇa kṛtvā paścādasyopaviśya ca | sarpo'sītyādika mantraṃ dadāmyantaṃ sakṛdvadet dhruvāmuṃ te paridadāmyetamuktvā nivedayet | jyeṣṭhānukramataḥ putrānaprattaduhitṝstathā || 5 || tataḥ patnī dhruvāmuṃ ta ityādyāvartate'tra tu | vācyaṃ putrādināmātra dvitīyāntamamuṃpade || dhruvamātmeti cā''tmānaṃ tataḥ paridadāti saḥ | anyaḥ kurvaṃti caidāha gṛhiṇo nāma māṃpade sānnaṃ prātaśca mantreṇa tenāpratyavarohaṇāt | balimeva harenneha namaskārādiriṣyate ||8|| sāyaṃ prātaśca yāvantaḥ kālāḥ syustaddinādadhaḥ | tāvato vā balīṃstasminnevāhani haredatha || 9 || iti sarpabaliḥ |
